2123257784758358326.en_summary: Cullen Roche explains basic bank accounting: deposits are assets for holders and liabilities for banks; reserves are bank assets and Fed liabilities to banks only, not to depositors. Individuals cannot hold reserves; only banks can. Cash withdrawal is the sole way to hold a Fed liability.
2123257784758358326.zh_summary: Cullen Roche 解釋基本銀行會計：存款對持有人是資產、對銀行是負債；準備金是銀行資產、聯準會僅對銀行的負債，並非對存款人。個人無法持有準備金，只有銀行可以。提領現金是持有聯準會負債的唯一方式。
